title: Governed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
title_zh: 面向多智能体 LLM 系统的受治理共享记忆
abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM environments require robust mechanisms for shared knowledge management. This paper formalizes the fleet-memory problem and identifies four foundational failure modes: unauthorized leakage, stale propagation, contradiction persistence, and provenance collapse. To address these, we define explicit systems-level primitives: scoped retrieval, temporal supersession, provenance tracking, and policy-governed memory propagation. These primitives are implemented in MemClaw, a production multi-tenant memory service, and evaluated via ArgusFleet, a reproducible harness testing four governance dimensions. Rather than a baseline comparison, this study measures a live production service, emphasizing real-world architectural insights and negative results. Key Evaluation Results Provenance: Successfully reconstructed 100% of depth-four derivation chains with correct writer identity at sub-second per-hop latency. Propagation: Demonstrated high intra-fleet visibility with zero cross-fleet leakage. Under strong write mode, write-to-visible latency was optimized to a single search round-trip. Production Architectural Issues Discovered Asymmetric Scope Enforcement: Tenant isolation held, but sub-tenant scope was initially bypassed on direct GET-by-id requests for agent-scoped credentials (disclosed and remediated during the study). Pipeline Ordering Conflict: While contradiction supersession works for admitted writes, a synchronous near-duplicate gate can prematurely reject contradictory writes before the asynchronous contradiction detector can evaluate them. Conclusion: Long-context retrieval alone is insufficient for production multi-agent memory. Governed shared memory demands explicit systems-level abstractions, and live evaluation is vital to expose enforcement and pipeline-ordering failures missed by design-only treatments.
abstract_zh: 多智能体 LLM 环境需要可靠的共享知识管理机制。本文形式化定义了 fleet-memory 问题，并指出四类基础失效模式：未授权泄漏、陈旧信息传播、矛盾持续存在以及溯源崩塌。为解决这些问题，作者提出了显式的系统级原语，包括 scoped retrieval（作用域检索）、temporal supersession（时间性取代）、provenance tracking（溯源追踪）和 policy-governed memory propagation（策略治理的记忆传播）。这些原语被实现于生产级多租户记忆服务 MemClaw，并通过可复现实验框架 ArgusFleet 在四个治理维度上进行评估。该研究并非传统基线对比，而是测量真实生产服务，强调实际架构洞察与负面结果。实验显示，系统可在亚秒级逐跳延迟下，100% 正确重建深度为四的推导链及写入者身份；在传播方面，实现了高 fleet 内可见性且无跨 fleet 泄漏，并在 strong write 模式下将写入到可见延迟优化为一次搜索往返。同时，研究发现了两个生产架构问题：直接按 id GET 时曾绕过 agent-scoped 凭据的子租户作用域限制；同步近重复过滤可能在异步矛盾检测前提前拒绝矛盾写入。论文结论是，仅依赖长上下文检索不足以支撑生产级多智能体记忆，受治理共享记忆需要显式系统抽象与真实线上评估。
key_points_zh: 论文形式化 fleet-memory 问题，并总结四类核心失效：unauthorized leakage、stale propagation、contradiction persistence 和 provenance collapse。
提出四个系统级治理原语：scoped retrieval、temporal supersession、provenance tracking 与 policy-governed memory propagation，用于约束共享记忆的访问、更新、溯源和传播。
实现了生产级多租户记忆服务 MemClaw，并使用 ArgusFleet 对 provenance、propagation 等治理维度进行可复现实测，而非仅做离线基线比较。
评估结果显示，MemClaw 可 100% 重建深度四的推导链并保持正确写入者身份，同时实现 fleet 内高可见性和零跨 fleet 泄漏。
真实生产评估暴露了设计阶段难以发现的问题，包括子租户作用域绕过和近重复过滤与矛盾检测之间的流水线顺序冲突。

llm_assessment.comment: Governed shared memory is highly relevant infrastructure work because it exposes production failure modes and defines reusable governance primitives.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 受治理的共享记忆是非常相关的基础设施工作，因为它揭示了生产故障模式并定义了可复用的治理原语。
